title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Refuelling Charge
content:
**Clause 1.** Equipment returned with less fuel than at checkout is billed a refuelling charge once per agreement as one refuelling line; equipment returned with at least the fuel it went out with carries none.

**Clause 2.** The eighths missing are the fuel level at checkout less the fuel level at return, in eighths of a tank, and never below zero. Both levels are the readings recorded on the Ridgeline Tool Rental agreement.

**Clause 3.** The refuelling charge is the eighths missing multiplied by the class price per eighth, plus the class refuelling service fee once when any eighth is missing, rounded to the nearest cent once at the end. The class price per eighth and the class refuelling service fee are the figures on the return fee schedule.

## Worked examples (hypothetical returns)

| Class figures | Fuel out | Fuel in | Eighths missing | Refuelling charge |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Rental Lawn and Landscape: 6.50 per eighth, 5.00 service fee | 8 | 5 | 3 | 3 multiplied by 6.50 is 19.50, plus 5.00: 24.50 |
| Ridgeline Rental Aerial and Lifting: 9.00 per eighth, 10.00 service fee | 6 | 5 | 1 | 9.00 plus 10.00: 19.00 |
| Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment: 18.00 per eighth, 15.00 service fee | 4 | 4 | 0 | none |
| Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment | 4 | 6 | 0 (never below zero) | none |

## Points of judgement

- *The renter brought the unit back fuller than it left. Is anything credited?* No; the eighths missing never go below zero and the unit carries no refuelling charge.
- *Is the service fee charged per eighth?* No; it is added once when any eighth is missing.
